body: Correction 0df02c4 pushed on wp/B5-16 for fbd39d94. Internal CopyResult/CopyError distinguishes typed Cancelled from Failed(BridgeError); finalizer maps result without reading a later cancel flag. Typed checkpoints, native EngineError::Cancelled and precommit rejection retain cancellation classification through layer/raster/IO path. Genuine validation/evaluator/write/persist failures preserved. Running-drain admission and commit race semantics unchanged. Two source tests UNRUN: gated failure/cancel finalization race (evaluator/validation/write labels) with admission held, and typed cancellation versus bridge/engine/IO failure mapping. Native adapter also no longer overwrites specialized failure with later cancellation or infers legacy BridgeError cancellation from flag. Limitation: old menu/effect paths erase types; ambiguous legacy cancellation may surface as Failure, never string/flag guessing. Future typed legacy effect path needed for reliable distinction. See tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/PSD-COPY-ERROR-PRECEDENCE.md. Rustfmt/diff-check only; no builds/tests/bindings/apps/benchmark/heartbeat restart. No Swift/shell/render/compositor edits. A owns compilation, remaining compositor work and main merges.
